NTA warns of legal action over fake, AI-generated NEET OMR sheets

The National Testing Agency (NTA) has issued a warning regarding the submission of fake and AI-generated OMR sheets for the NEET-UG exam. This action follows complaints about discrepancies between expected and declared scores. The NTA stated that legal action will be taken against those submitting fraudulent documents, and clarified that viral OMR sheets were AI-generated and not a result of mix-ups.
